# Sthitha Quantum Innovations

> Sthitha Quantum Innovations Pvt Ltd is a quantum technology company in Bengaluru, India, working across quantum computing, post-quantum security, education and research. Its initiatives are Sthitha Exodia (post-quantum security), Sthitha Academy (quantum education) and Research & Innovation.

Full text of every article: https://sthithaquantum.com/llms-full.txt

## Company
- [About Sthitha](https://sthithaquantum.com/about/): Who we are, mission, vision and three areas of work
- [Our Team](https://sthithaquantum.com/our-team/): Core team and their publications
- [Events](https://sthithaquantum.com/events/): Community engagement, including sponsorship of AURORA '26 (2–3 October 2026)
- [Partnerships](https://sthithaquantum.com/partnerships/): Collaboration in quantum education, research and post-quantum security
- [Contact](https://sthithaquantum.com/contact/): Enquiries and head office details

## Sthitha Exodia — post-quantum security
- [Sthitha Exodia](https://sthithaquantum.com/exodia/): Helps organisations discover cryptographic assets, assess quantum risk and prepare for post-quantum migration (Discover, Protect, Migrate)

## Sthitha Academy — quantum education
- [Academy overview](https://sthithaquantum.com/academy/): Quantum computing courses for beginners
- [Quantum Computing Crash Course: Qubits to Shor & Grover](https://sthithaquantum.com/academy/quantum-computing-crash-course/): English, self-paced on Udemy, 1 hour 19 minutes, 5 lectures
- [Quantum Computing in Malayalam: For Beginners](https://sthithaquantum.com/academy/quantum-computing-malayalam/): Beginner course taught in Malayalam, on Udemy
